recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow fix to active current-build source that removes a contradictory forgotten parallel location without altering the already-correct CareTeam page.
issue_request: FHIR-25290 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for the CareTeam Boundaries and Relationships section.
